inputs.gold:top: top gold difference vs the opposing top / 1000
inputs.gold:jungle: jungle gold difference vs the opposing jungle / 1000
inputs.gold:mid: mid gold difference vs the opposing mid / 1000
inputs.gold:bot: bot gold difference vs the opposing bot / 1000
inputs.gold:support: support gold difference vs the opposing support / 1000
inputs.draft: the pro draft model's logit at equal ratings, without its side term (blue's view)
inputs.scaling: sum of blue's champion scaling scores - red's

pro.notUsed: objectives (dragons, towers, heralds, barons, firsts): Oracle's Elixir has only whole-game totals, which include what happens after the snapshot (leakage); void grubs (complete by 20 min) and assists were tested and added nothing

scaling.measure: slope of the champion's win rate (log-odds) per 10 minutes of game length in ranked solo queue (data/matches.db, games of 15+ minutes), shrunk by empirical Bayes and centred; a team's score is the sum over its five champions

draftPhase.model: draft model fitted on the four years before each game (2026: 2022-2025; 2025: 2021-2024), equal team ratings

solo.model: logistic regression per game minute (src/winprob_solo.py): coefficients fitted at every 2nd minute on the rows of minutes m-2..m+2 (weights 1,2,3,2,1), odd minutes interpolated; minutes past 40 use 40

scaling.measure: slope of the champion's win rate (log-odds) per 10 minutes of game length in these ranked solo games, empirical-Bayes shrunk and centred (cross-fitted by game in the model's training rows); a team's score is the sum over its five champions
scaling.timelineMeasure: champion x game-time residual slope: how much a champion's team out- or under-performs the state-based win probability (the model without scaling) per 10 minutes of game time (log-odds per 10 min, centred at 20:00), ridge-shrunk (penalty 1000 games); reported, not used in the model: it predicted held-out games less well than the length slope

valid.split: last 15% of games by date held out

gbm.note: HistGradientBoosting on the full features + minute (500k training rows; run with timeline scaling), vs logistic full 0.5022 on the same features

events.note: direct: the model's change in the team's win probability when the event's own features are added to the real states at that minute, gold and everything else held fixed (pp; a death also gives the opponent of the same position 300 gold); swing: the team's win probability change over the game minute the event happened in, minus the average change of states at the same minute and win probability (pp; includes the fight around it)

items.note: team win probability change from the last minute before the item was completed to 5 minutes after it (the full model), minus the average change of states at the same minute and win probability decile (pp per completion; games that ended in the window are left out)

sources.solo: data/matches.db (Riot match-v5 crawl: ranked solo, high-ranked players on EUW, KR, NA and OCE)
sources.pro: Oracle's Elixir match data (oracleselixir.com), data/raw/oracle/<year>_oe.csv, downloaded 2026-09-22
